people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city

people.name: Rabshakeh
people.line: A Babylonian official who taunted Hezekiah and Jerusalem's people

translations.web: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
translations.bsb: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
translations.kjv: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
